## Entry points

  request. Tal is a top-level orchestrator, not a subagent.
- **Seed refresh / retrospective:** `claude --agent scout`.

## How to hand off work (Claude Code)

Subagent calls are **synchronous**: the subagent runs to completion in its own
context and sees none of your conversation — everything it needs goes in the
`prompt` (case ID, AFS path, branch name, user set, slot name).

**Single subagent:**

    Agent(
      subagent_type="qa-engineer",
      prompt="Analyst slot — analyse ELITEA-1739 per the test-case-analysis skill.
              Case file: ../onetest-ai-tm-Elitea/tests/automated-full-regression-ui/skills/....md
              Target: http://localhost:5173 (start via start-ui-localhost skill).
              Return the AFS path + status."
    )

**Parallel subagents** — multiple `Agent()` calls in ONE assistant turn. Only for
independent surfaces; cases touching the same page object run serial.

**Reviewer must be a FRESH session** — never reuse the analyst's session for review.

## Routing rules
